title: MamaReason: Unfinished Reasoning and Answer Recovery in Clinical Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Answer continuation often returns a diagnosis already stated in unfinished clinical reasoning. We study this behavior in MamaReason, adapted from dense Gemma 4 31B, on MamaBench's 217 paired maternal and child-health presentations. An explicit-commitment extractor identifies a diagnosis in 75 of 94 failed RL first passes and 75 of 93 failed SFT first passes. The continuation matches that diagnosis in 67/75 RL cases and 58/75 SFT cases, using diagnosis strings alone. Reading these commitments without additional generation recovers 30 of the 40 RL pairs restored by continuation under the archived correctness labels. Recurrence controls distinguish routine mentions from repeated answer selection. An offline second-commitment trigger measures the tradeoff between earlier readout and paired accuracy. translated_title: MamaReason：临床语言模型中的未完成推理与答案恢复
translated_abstract: 答案续写常常返回一个在未完成的临床推理中早已陈述过的诊断。我们在 MamaReason（由稠密的 Gemma 4 31B 适配而来）上，针对 MamaBench 的 217 组配对母婴健康病例演示研究了这一行为。一个显式承诺提取器在 94 例强化学习（RL）首次通过失败的案例中识别出 75 例已有诊断，在 93 例监督微调（SFT）首次通过失败的案例中识别出 75 例已有诊断。仅使用诊断字符串，续写答案与该诊断匹配的情况为 RL 中的 67/75 例、SFT 中的 58/75 例。在归档的正确性标签下，不进行任何额外生成而直接读取这些承诺，即可恢复续写在 40 个 RL 配对中挽救的 30 个。复发控制实验区分了推理轨迹中的常规提及与重复的答案选择。一个离线的二次承诺触发器量化了更早读取与配对准确率之间的权衡。由此得到的分解方法可将推理轨迹中已存在的诊断内容、对已接受答案的补全以及配对诊断一致性区分开来。
tldr: 该研究发现临床语言模型通过答案续写恢复的诊断大多已显式存在于未完成的推理轨迹中，仅直接读取这些诊断承诺（无需额外生成）即可挽救大部分续写所恢复的失败案例。
en_tdlr: The study finds that diagnoses recovered via answer continuation in clinical language models are mostly already explicitly present in the unfinished reasoning trace, and simply reading these explicit commitments without additional generation restores most continuation-rescued failures.
